claims.answer: Desktop installers cover macOS Universal, Windows x64 and Linux x86-64; native iOS/Android apps, a hosted web app and the lody CLI expose the workspace. notifications.answer: Push notifications (task completion, approvals, PR-ready), iOS Live Activities with actionable permission alerts, and in-app/terminal notifications.
